image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a butterfly resting on a textured grey rock. The butterfly has its wings held vertically closed, displaying the ventral (underwing) surface which is primarily brownish-grey with a distinct orange patch on the forewing and faint eyespots. The body appears fuzzy/hairy and brown. One antenna is visible, appearing segmented and clubbed at the tip. Legs are thin and spindly, gripping the rock surface.
